messages:
maya: Hi all — day 0 and running into a permissions snag. I can sign into the Console but when I try to open the staging admin panel I get a 403. Who do I ask to add me for feature-flag and readonly admin access?
jordan: welcome Maya! @jordan here. For staging Console access we usually grant `console:staging-admin-read` first. File a request in the infra-access board or ping infra with your employee id and which org/project you need access to.
maya: thanks — employee id 10432 and I need access to the payments and routing projects in staging. Is there a template I should use?
jordan: quick template — paste this to infra: `name: Maya S; id: 10432; env: staging; projects: payments,routing; scopes: console:staging-admin-read`. Also add a note if you need feature flag flip rights (that’s a separate approval).
maya: got it. Do I need to contact the flag owners directly for flip rights?
alex: hey Maya — alex from infra. You can request toggle rights but we require sign-off from the flag owners. For Payments flags ping @dev-payments and @platform-gatekeepers. For any high-risk flags we escalate to eng-sre. If you just need to view flag configs, the read scope is enough.
maya: perfect. Can infra give a temporary 24h elevated access while I get approvals?
alex: yeah — we can do a timeboxed role. Please open the infra-access ticket and in the body put `temp_elevated: 24h` and list the exact flags needing changes. We'll attach the approval workflow and send a link back once done.
infra-bot: [automated] Access request created: ticket #INFR-4782 by maya. Status: awaiting approvers. Link: https://redwood.internal/infr/tickets/INFR-4782
maya: thanks everyone — submitted the ticket and pinged the owners. Appreciate the help :heart:
jordan: once you're unblocked, ping me if you want a quick walkthrough of the Console FF audit logs and the safe flip playbook. It helps avoid accidental wide-rollouts.
maya: will do. One last Q: is there a staging VPN or SSO trick I should know about? I saw a SSO prompt earlier.
alex: SSO is required for admin scopes, make sure you use SSO and MFA. If you see SSO errors, try clearing cookies or use incognito once — occasionally AAD sessions hang. If that fails, we can force a session reset from our side.
maya: ok copying notes. thank you!
maya: @jordan @alex tagging you in case the approvers need extra context.
